data.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd
data.about: Larsen & Toubro Ltd is a multinational conglomerate which is primarily engaged in providing engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) solutions in key sectors such as Infrastructure, Hydrocarbon, Power, Process Industries and Defence, Information Technology and Financial Services in domestic and international markets.[1]

data.what_it_does: L&T is an engineering and construction conglomerate that delivers EPC projects and industrial products to infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, and technology sectors globally. It serves diverse clients including governments, process industries, defence, and enterprises through integrated project execution and technology solutions.

bull.text: The company delivered a 3-year revenue CAGR of 16% and PAT CAGR of 14.8% with TTM revenue of ₹300,904 Cr and PAT of ₹20,895 Cr.
Management reports a domestic order prospect pipeline of ₹7.45 trillion (49% of ₹15.07 trillion) with private sector contribution around 45%.
The Lakshya L31 strategic plan targets 13-15% revenue CAGR over five years with EBIT margins of 16-17%.

bear.text: High leverage is flagged with debt-to-equity of 1.24 and operating cash flow to PAT of only 0.85 over three years.
Operating margin has declined from 14.8% three years ago to 12.7% currently despite revenue growth.

Massive capex commitments totaling over ₹374 billion across Green Hydrogen (₹150B), Data Centers (₹100B), Industrial Electronics (₹50B), Semiconductors (₹30B), Realty (₹44B), and hydrocarbon/shipbuilding (₹50B) pose execution risk.
